content: ABOUT US Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. - We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Content Programs Manager to own Legora's webinar and digital events program globally. This is the person who turns a scattered calendar of one-off webinars into a set of formats people show up for on purpose: recurring series, seasonal programs and digital moments that build an audience over time. Half of this role is production and operations: run of show, platform, speaker prep, rehearsal, promotion timeline, follow-up. The other half is programming: deciding what we should be making, who should be on it, what the format actually is, and why a partner at a global law firm would give us forty-five minutes of their day. Earlier, this means independently owning a workstream with visible owners, deadlines and dependencies, and communicating changes and their implications early. With more experience, it means planning and leading complex rollouts, knowing when to use the standard playbook and when to vary it, running governance properly, and adjusting the plan as the environment shifts. - Stakeholder management. Earlier, this means being reliable and responsive, setting expectations you then meet, and knowing when to escalate. With more experience, it means holding trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, surfacing concerns before they become blockers, resolving tension between groups, and coaching others on how to do the same. - Thought leadership. Earlier, this means explaining confidently and accurately what AI does and does not do for legal work, and what that means for how lawyers practise. With more experience, it means leading external discussions in multiple forums, and turning what you see in the field into narratives, enablement material and product input the wider company uses. You do not need to have held a Legal Engineering role before. The profession is new and almost nobody has ten years of it. What matters is whether the underlying capability is there, in whatever setting you built it. SENIORITY, TITLE AND LEVEL We are hiring across the full range for this team, from roughly one year of relevant experience after qualification through to ten years and beyond. Titles run from Legal Engineering Associate through Legal Engineer, Senior Legal Engineer and Lead Legal Engineer. Apply once. Title and level are decided at the offer stage, based on your experience and what you demonstrate in the process, not on the title you hold today. If you are more senior than you expected to be reading this, say so and we will calibrate properly. WHAT YOU BRING You will thrive in this role if you: - Have a legal qualification and real experience of substantive legal work, either at a law firm or in an in-house legal function.
